publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper presents the multi-UAVs cooperative target observation and tracking considering the communication interference and the propagation loss. UAVs are assigned to the appropriate target group which maximises information defined by the Fisher information matrix (FIM). We propose multi-UAVs cooperative target optimal measurement and tracking models considering the communication factors. Using the rolling horizon optimization method for optimal solution. The main contributions of this paper are threefold. Firstly, this paper proposes a new method of target tracking by considering the communication interference and the propagation loss. Secondly, UAVs are assigned to the appropriate target group which maximises information defined by the FIM. Lastly, using Information Consensus Filter (ICF) to solve the convergence problem and improve topology.

articleTitle: Design and research of new large flow three-way pressure compensation valve
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In the hydraulic systems with fixed displacement pump, there is a problem that the flow of three - way pressure compensation valve working with LUDV multi-way valve is low. So a new large flow pressure compensation valve was designed. The valve contains a main channel and two overflow channels. Through bench test and field experiments, the new large flow three-way pressure compensated valve was verified with good unloading pressure characteristics and good pressure compensation characteristics in large flow working conditions. The flow of new valve can reach 400 L/min and unloading pressure can reduce to 3MPa. Thus, the new valve meets the requirements of LUDV multi-way valve under large flow condition. The new large flow three-way pressure compensation valve makes an important contribution to the further research on multi-way valve.

articleTitle: Research on algorithm of braking pressure estimating for anti-lock braking system of motorcycle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: An effective pressure estimation algorithm of ABS for motorcycles was proposed in this paper to get the relatively accurate wheel cylinder pressure. Firstly, the performance characteristics of hydraulic control unit was studied and the vehicle model was established by using BikeSim. Next, the pressure estimation algorithms of master cylinder and wheel cylinder were studied. The estimated pressure is modified according to different vehicle braking stages. Finally, based on an actual motorcycle the wheel cylinder pressure was obtained under different pavements and braking initial speeds by ABS experimental platform to validate the effectiveness of wheel cylinder pressure estimation algorithm. The results show that the actual wheel cylinder pressure can be well tracked by the estimated wheel cylinder pressure with an allowable pressure error.

articleTitle: Design of aircraft center of gravity control law based on sliding mode control
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A sliding mode based active center of gravity control law is designed for the aircraft with center of gravity varying during flight. As the basis, the general scheme of the active center of gravity control system is proposed, and the mathematic model of aircraft center of gravity varying with fuel transfer is established. Then, the center of gravity control law based on sliding mode control theory is designed, which can guarantee the control error converges to zero in finite time. Finally, simulations are carried out to verify the proposed method. Simulation results show that the sliding mode based center of gravity control law can accurately and rapidly track the given command for various different fuel transfer conditions.

articleTitle: Life estimation based on unbalanced data for hydraulic pump
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper focuses on statistic method under small test samples through re-sampling for aeronautics pump. Based on the limit accelerated life testing samples and regular life testing samples, this paper presents a life evaluation method combing the Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique (SMOTE) algorithm, Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test and accumulated damage theory. SMOTE algorithm is used to solve the imbalance between sample groups, while KS is a classic way to evaluate the goodness of fitting. The maximum likelihood estimation of proposed method shows that the sample group can be expanded efficiently with the goodness-of-fit being guaranteed.

articleTitle: Life evaluation based on double linear damage rule for hydraulic pump piston fatigue
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Double Linear Damage Rule (DLDR) is commonly used in analyzing cumulative fatigue damage. Compared with the Linear Damage Rule (LDR), the DLDR takes into account the long established fact that order of loading significantly affects the summation of the cycle ratios at failure. This paper presents a method for calculating the fatigue life, by analyzing the actual load spectrum of a certain type of hydraulic pump, the fatigue life of piston was obtained with DLDR, the ANSYS software was used to simulate the fatigue life according to the actual load distribution of the piston. The life of piston calculated by DLDR and that simulated by ANSYS conform with the actual situation. This paper shows that the DLDR theory applied to the fatigue life evaluation is feasible and effective, and is of great guiding significance to the development and optimization of aircraft components.

articleTitle: Inlaid connection of carbon fibre reinforced plastic cylinder
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In recent years, composites represented by carbon fibre reinforced plastic (CFRP) are gradually applied to the manufacturing of hydraulic cylinder parts and components. To connect different kind of materials, convenience of maintaining or disassembly, structural integrity of composites and material utilization should be taken into consideration. In this paper, on the basis of summarizing the technology and achievements related to composite cylinders, a new method called inlaid connection, which can be applied during the CFRP hydraulic cylinder's manufacturing, is proposed in order to improve disassembly's convenience, connection's reliability, material's utilization rate and structural integrity.

articleTitle: Analysis of propeller lift force based on FLUENT
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to calculate the lift force of propeller using simulation software FLUENT. And on the basis of this, a certain degree of applicability of the formula from blade element theory is verified. It also presents suggestions for the analysis of the lift force of the propeller in the case of the impact of the incoming flow.

articleTitle: Halon substitute fire-extinguishing agent HFC-125 concentration measurement based on infrared absorption and the research on the effect of relative humidity
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: As a new kind of halon substitute fire-extinguishing agent, HFC-125(pentafluoroethane) has been gradually and widely used nowadays. Both in the ground simulation and the flight test of fire suppression systems for aircrafts, measurement equipment of agent concentration is necessary and indispensable. In this work, based on the IR absorption principle, measurement equipment of HFC-125 concentration has been designed. By the experiment results, this concentration measurement shows a relative error of the system less than ±1.90%. The research on interference factor-relative humidity has been studied in this paper.

articleTitle: Factors of the stability of aircraft 270V DC power supply system with constant power load
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The main load of MEA (More Electric Aircraft) is constant power electrical load. Because of this loads having a negative impedance characteristic, when the system is under perturbation, the fluctuation voltage of constant power loads will be amplified, and even lead to serious failure of the entire electrical system. This paper mainly studied the factors which influence the stability under 270V HVDC (High Voltage DC) power. According to the characteristics of electrical load and stable condition of DC power supply system, this paper analyzed equivalent circuit, deduced the characteristic polynomial of the transfer function and then obtained a similar system stability criterion depending on Routh Criterion. This paper also built a simulation circuit of on-board power supply system with CPL (Constant Power Load)and made theoretical verification. The result indicated that the stability criteria is in line with the simulation results. In the end, an improved method was proposed to increase the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of pump-controlled dual-winch system with PI controller
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: As for the synchronization control of dual winches of large crawler cranes, a master-slave PI control algorithm with the hook's inclination as feedback signal is proposed and analyzed. The transfer function of the pump-controlled dual-winch system is obtained by building the mathematical model and linearizing it around the working point and thus the stability can be analyzed. The way to determine the parameters of PI controller is proposed via frequency response method. The research indicates that the proposed control algorithm is able to guarantee the steady-state error to be zero and that the stability of the whole system depends on the stability of the hydraulic subsystem and the actuator subsystem. Specifically, the stability of the hydraulic system can be ensured by increasing leakage and the stability of the actuator can be improved through PI controller.

articleTitle: Finite-element modeling and impedance characteristics analysis of two parallel cables in aircraft power system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The impedance of cables is crucial in aircraft power system, it can affect the system performance characteristics. The cables impedance is influenced by power supply frequency and wiring mode, due to skin effect and proximity effect. In this paper the impedance characteristics of two parallel cables in aircraft power system are studied through the co-simulation with a Maxwell 2D finite element model of the cables and Simplorer models of other circuit components. The impedance of the cable under test is calculated by the co-simulation model. The impedance variations of the cable under test are obtained with the changes of power frequency, amplitude and phase of the current flowing through the adjacent cable. The causes of the impedance variations are analyzed by using the space vector method and current density distribution, magnetic flux distribution within and around the cable under test.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis for BLDCM system used FFT algorithm and support vector machines
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: To effectively solve the fault diagnosis problem of BLDCM unbalanced three-phase winding under the unsteady case, this article puts forward a fault diagnosis method based on Support Vector Machine (SVM) and FFT. Using FFT to analyze the time-frequency of local signal can extract fault features, which are utilized for SVM training. Once satisfied effects are achieved, SVM structure and internal parameters should be freezed. To compare the output and fault codes with given input can realize the goal of winding unbalanced fault diagnosis. At the same time, to simulate the unbalanced three-phase winding by building BLDCM position servo model with MATLAB/SIMULINK verifies the validity of the proposed fault diagnosis method. The example simulation results show that the method can not only diagnose fault existence, but also judge the level of fault effectively. As a reliable fault diagnosis approach, the method is simple and effective with the capability of making up existing flaws.

articleTitle: Multifractal characterization of plunger pump vibration signal through improved empirical mode decomposition based detrended fluctuation analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Promptly and accurately detecting the plunger pump fault in the hydraulic system is a serious issue in terms of improving reliability and decreasing accidents. A main work is analyzing the character of the collected samples. We used an improved empirical mode decomposition (EMD) based multifractal detrended fluctuation analysis (MFDFA) to extract the multifractal characters. The current method utilizes intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) selection and Kolmogorov - Smirnov test (K-S test) in the detrending procedure. The IMFs selection is used to deal with the undesired IMFs, and the two-sample K-S test works on each IMF and Gaussian noise to detect the noise-like IMFs. The proposed method adaptive to the nature of data and weakening the effect of noise make this approach work well for the non-stationary signal from the real system. We used the proposed method on the plunger pump vibration signal in the hydraulic system to verify the present of multifractal.

articleTitle: A self-tuning fuzzy-PID stabilization experiment of a seeker inertial platform's tracking loop subject to input saturation and dead-zone
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Due to the high-frequency disturbances and fast velocity, the seeker dynamic characteristics in an missile or the airborne opto-electronic platform changes dramatically, leading to time-varying and nonlinear tracking loop (also called position loop) error. The traditional PID scheme using constant parameters cannot achieve high performance in terms of either accuracy or fast response. In this paper, a self-tuning fuzzy PID control strategy that consider the saturation and dead-zone is proposed, where the PID coefficients K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>, K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub> are adjusted according to the response of the system in real time using a pre-designed fuzzy rule. Specifically, the fuzzy-PID controller selecting position loop error and its changing rate as observed value is developed with online modification of proportion, integration and derivative parameters. The principle prototype of radar seeker made by our research team helps to carry out both of static and dynamic servo control experiments. It seems that the results demonstrate that performance of the platform is improved significantly against the traditional PID control, in terms of both faster leveling speed and high precision steady precision.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of a direct drive reversing valve for the hydraulic die forging hammer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: As the core component of the hydraulic die forging hammer, the main reversing valve controls the strike and return action of the hammer. It has high cost and poor stability since driven by hydraulic pressure, which needs a separately hydraulic circuit and it is unable to control the valve core precisely. In order to improve the speed control accuracy and position precision, a new drive method based on TPMLM (tubular permanent magnet linear motor) is designed in this paper. The mathematical models of the original reversing valve and the improved one are built. Theoretical calculation and simulation on the fluid force analysis are discussed to verify the method. The simulation performance is conduct to compare response characteristic between the two hydraulic systems based on AMESim. The results indicate that the new drive method exhibits a faster response of the reversing valve.

articleTitle: Active fault-tolerant control of large commercial aircraft with asymmetric damaged horizontal stabilizer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper designs an active fault-tolerant controller based on Model Reference Adaptive Control (MRAC) and Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) for horizontal stabilizer asymmetric damaged large aircraft. Defining the parameters of damaged horizontal stabilizer, MRAC detects healthy result of the aircraft and switch HA to EHA. LQR regulator accepts the damage ratio of horizontal stabilizer and regulate the parameters of MRAC. Simulation results indicate that the proposed active fault tolerant controller based on MRAC and linear LQR is more feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Low temperature characteristic analysis and enhancement of hydraulic system on high-altitude and long-endurance unmanned vehicle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Compared with other aircraft types, the operating ambient temperature of high-altitude and long-endurance unmanned vehicle is much lower. This paper addresses the low temperature characteristic of hydraulic system on a high-altitude and long-endurance unmanned vehicle. Some enhancement methodologies are discussed and a self-cycle heating method is recommended to improve the low temperature performance of hydraulic system. The experiments show that the analysis and enhancement methodology is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: A study of the weighted least squares support vector machine within the Bayesian evidence framework
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Short-term load forecasting is essential in the safely assigning of every electricity production and distribution facility. So a short-term load forecasting model and algorithm based on the weighted least squares support vector machine within the Bayesian evidence framework is proposed. The optimal parameters of models can be found through three-layer Bayesian evidence inference. To improve the robustness of the model, WLS-SVM regression model with good generalization performance is established by giving a different weight coefficient to each sample error, which further improves the prediction accuracy of the model.

Author Keywords: Weighted least squares support vector machines

articleTitle: Analysis of position-based impedance control method and the composition of system dynamic compliance
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The hydraulic drive legged robot with high performance is introduced in this paper. When the robotic foot contacts the ground, the collision and impact can easily take place. Therefore, the robotic leg joint should possess certain compliance. In order to enhance the compliance of robotic leg joint, the paper researches the position-based impedance control method. Besides, the analysis for the composition of compliance is proposed, which lays the theoretical foundation for the dynamic compliance compensation control. To be specific, the force analysis for the hydraulic drive unit of robotic leg joint is conducted to research the method of impedance control and the impedance control link is introduced to the control system outer loop. Moreover, through building the mechanism model of hydraulic drive unit, the formula derivation and the theoretical analysis are conducted to obtain the series composition theory of system dynamic compliance. The control effect of impedance control method is verified through the experiment on the hydraulic drive unit performance test platform. The experiment proves the effectiveness of the position-based impedance control method for enhancing the compliance of hydraulic drive unit position control system as well as the series composition theory of system dynamic compliance. Thus, the research in this paper can give certain guiding significance to the dynamic compliance compensation control and the dynamic compliance compound control of the position control system in future.

articleTitle: Dual linear motors synchronous control for horizontal axis of far-field target motion simulators
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper proposes a simple synchronous control scheme for a linear servo system applied to driving the horizontal axis of far-field target motion simulators(TMS). The investigated horizontal axis is driven by two parallel linear motors, which are arranged at both ends of the vertical axis. This layout, which can improve the system dynamics, overall thrust and structural stiffness, requires accurate synchronous control. To meet this requirement, the velocity difference compensation scheme is proposed to reduce the synchronous errors. Prior to this, the parallel synchronous control model of dual linear motors is established, and a stiffness coefficient is introduced to consider the impact of the mechanical connection coupling between these two linear motors. The performance of the proposed method is verified by a S-curve motion profile, and the simulation results substantiate the effectiveness of the control method.

articleTitle: Integral backstepping control of servo actuators with LuGre model-based friction compensation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper concerns high-accuracy tracking control for servo actuators with nonlinear friction compensation. Friction is a major factor that affects the performance of the servo system, in order to express the characteristics of nonlinear friction more accurately and improve the control performance of the system, the LuGre dynamic friction model is applied, it can more fully described the friction phenomena. Firstly, a nonlinear observer is designed to estimate the internal state of the LuGre model. Then, based on the estimated friction state, the unknown friction and load torque compensation are realized by the integral backstepping adaptive controller, and the stability of the closed loop system is proved by the Lyapunov function. The simulation results show that this algorithm improves the control performance of the system.

articleTitle: Sliding mode genetic control algorithm for variable pump driving variable motor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Variable pump driving variable motor (VPDVM) is an essentially nonlinear system with dual-input single-output and coupling. Regular control algorithms are difficult to achieve approving control effects on this kind of system. In this paper, the sliding mode genetic control algorithm is proposed for VPDVM. The algorithm mainly aims at solving problems of nonlinearity and unable-decoupling of VPDVM. First, the mathematical model of VPDVM is established. Secondly, as the model raised above has multiplying nonlinearity including the output variable, this nonlinear model is then linearized by feedback linearization theory. Finally, the sliding mode genetic control algorithm is presented to achieve the rapid motor response of VPDVM. Simulation results demonstrate that the algorithm proposed can implement the desired rapid control on VPDVM, and the performances are better than relative regular control methods. What's more, it's worth to notice that the algorithm can achieve good performance without knowing the gradient of VPDVM model.

articleTitle: Research on characteristics of pressure-resistant torque motor for 2D valve
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Since conventional electro-mechanical converter of 2D valve had deficiency of lacking high pressure resistance, a novel pressure-resistant torque motor with simple structure and limited working stroke was developed based on axial magnetic circuit with single-phase excitation. Prototype motor was fabricated and experimental rig was built. Torque-angle characteristics and frequency response were studied using approaches of FEM simulation and experiments. The experimental results were in a close agreement with the simulated results, which indicate the torque-angle characteristic is close to linear relationship and its amplitude increases with winding current. The maximum static torque reaches about 0.33 N·m. The dynamic response can meet engineering requirement for 2D proportional and directional valves.

articleTitle: Bond graph modeling and simulation analysis of direct drive volume control electro-hydraulic servo system with long pipeline
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper describes the composition and theory of a new kind of direct drive volume control electro-hydraulic servo system, in order to better express the nonlinear of systems and the input-output relationship of various variables, Power Bond Graph was used to establish bond graph model of the components and overall system, 20-sim software was used to simulation analysis that focus on the impact of the various factors such as pipe length and diameter on the system dynamic characteristics, the results showed that the length and diameter of the pipe should be reduced as far as possible in the case of the installation requirements has been satisfied.

articleTitle: Research on the electrical control technology of oxygen supply for multiple crew on large cargo airplane
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: According to the characteristics of large transport aircraft, the electrical control technology is required according to the configuration of multiple units and different units. Through the analysis of the flow characteristics of the flow limiting hole, the direct/indirect control technique is adopted to study the high pressure flux. The characteristics of electrical control and the control law are researched and the technical test and verification are completed.

articleTitle: Thoughts and analysis of some problems in the hydraulic control system design with the WBD
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper presents the system works, solution of the limited hydraulic source with the velocity inner loop, and the system optimal design method of reduction ratio. Through modeling and simplifying the system, the static and dynamic characteristics are analyzed, and the selecting requirements of affecting its parameters are proposed. A method is raised to reduce the peak pressure of the hydraulic drive unit (PDU) inlet and outlet pipes and its internal motor.

articleTitle: Analysis on water content of product gas in onboard oxygen generation system (OBOGS)
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: With the need of airplane for long endurance flight, the pilot raises new demand for the gas-water content of the product generated by OBOGS. For this reason, this paper conducted experiments with the system on the two types of oxygen-rich molecular sieves - NaX type and LiX type, which are used currently for domestic OBOGS under different operating conditions, conducted sampling analysis of the bleed air and product gas and obtained H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O content of the product gas, which provides reference for OBOGS researches.

articleTitle: An energy optimization type of power-by-wire integrated loading actuation system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of loading actuation's work pattern alternately switching between homodromous and converse load during the aircraft structure test especially in the fatigue loading test, an energy optimization type of power-by-wire valve-control integrated loading actuation system for aircraft structure test was designed. The system components and working principle was described. The loading scheme of the main and the minor valves working in different loading pattern was proposed. The modeling and simulation work of the energy optimization loading actuation system was completed. The feasibility of the main and the minor valves working in different loading pattern was proved. The simulation results demonstrate that the designed energy optimization type of power-by-wire valve-control integrated loading actuation system for aircraft structure test can improve the energy efficiency of the system obviously, and can be widely used in aircraft structural loading test system.

articleTitle: Optimization of the five phase fault tolerant motor based on ansoft simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Recent years, the development of the More Electric Aircraft is becoming more popular, the power supply system of 270 VDC is one of the important development trend. More electric-hydraulic components such as EMP and EHA driven by 270 VDC have shown more advantage compared to the components with the traditional electric power supply 115 VAC, which have been applied successfully in modern aircrafts, such as B787, F-22 and F-35. This paper proposes one novel permanent magnet brushless 270 VDC motor, which has five phases, six poles and 10 slots, 8000 rpm nominal speed for driving the high speed piston pump. The development of the motor is carried out with the help of Ansoft, where the geometry of the motor, the excitation source and motion attributes is discussed. The distribution of the static field and the counter electromotive force of transient no-load motor stator is derived as well. The magnetic field distributon of the motor is proved to be reasonable by static simulation. Transient simulation shows that the induced electromotive force generated in the motor windings of each phase is also reasonable, and the reluctance torque is within a reasonable range. The key structure parameters of the motor, such as the thickness of the permanent magnet and the permanent magnet pole arc coefficient, are optimized for stability, reliability, and power density.

articleTitle: Energy reverse transmission analysis of collaborative rectification structure pump
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper studies the energy reverse transmission of a new type collaborative rectification structure pump, which uses a linear reciprocal machine drives a piston directly to pump hydraulic fluid. This pump is designed for a novel electro-hydrostatic actuator which is a kind of volume control electro-hydraulic servo system. For servo control application, the pump is usually required to transfer energy in both positive and reverse direction, which means it not only can work as a pump, but also be required to work as a motor to drive the electrical machine as a generator. The purpose of this research is to study the characteristics of reverse transmission of this new pump. The kinematics flow rate model and dynamic model of the pump are presented firstly, and then a proof of the ability of reverse transmission and the stability criterion are discussed. Finally its characteristics in reverse transmission are verified based on simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect factors of the pressure relief process of the closed electro-hydraulic servo system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of the closed electro-hydraulic servo system, the system and its components are simulated and modeled in this paper. In the study of the pressure relief process after shutting down the servo system, servovalve is found to be related strongly with this process. Based on the modeling simulation results, verification tests show that the pressure relief time is influenced by the throttling level of the servovalve's core and filter, which means redundant substances can hinder the relief process. Follow-up tests show that the servovalve's internal leakage is proportional to the variation of the pressure relief time. In order to optimize the pressure relief process of the closed electro-hydraulic servo system, the servovalve's internal leakage is better to be under control.

articleTitle: Three-dimension thermal slide rheostats analysis of cylinder with medium alternation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In this paper, thermal slide rheostats of cylinder and thermal circuit network based on them have been studied. The object here is abstracted from part of cylinder in swashplate axial piston pump (SAPP) in electro-hydrostatic actuator (EHA). Obviously, this object occupies asymmetry of thermal processes and medium alternation in circumferential direction. As a result, a three-dimension thermal circuit network based on thermal slide rheostats has been proposed newly based on a two-dimension model presented by the same author. With necessary mathematical deduction and simulated analysis, characteristics and variation laws of related temperature field and thermal slide rheostats have been discussed in detail and several conclusions have been summarized in the end.

articleTitle: Research on several similarity criteria of ram air turbine operating under high-low altitude
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Ram Air Turbine System (“RAT System”) functions as an airborne emergency power system. How to verify high-altitude operating characteristics of RAT system using ground test results is a key research subject in the design of RAT system. The author adopts CFD numerical simulation method to analyze the high-low altitude aerodynamic performance of a certain type of ram air turbine, compares the operating performances of the turbine under high and low altitude, and analyzes the correlation between high and low altitude performances of a RAT system. In this paper, the CFD numerical simulation method to study the similarity criteria of RAT operating under high-low altitude is used, and it is expected to provide references for the design of subsequent RAT models.

articleTitle: The study on performance of power generation system by heat energy based on R113
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper proposed a new concept that we could make the power generation system by heat energy which was on the basis of Rankine cycle combine with the environmental control system in aircraft to recycle the waste heat of engine bleed air with high temperature and generate power. This paper mainly discussed three aspects on the working fluid named R113 which was applied to this particular technology as following: (1) the rule of the system thermal efficiency varying with the temperature of bleed air (2) the influence on the outlet temperature of bleed air caused by the evaporation temperature of R113 (3) the influence on the outlet temperature of bleed air caused by the mass flow of R113.

articleTitle: Recognition and analysis of pilots' landing visual error
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The eye tracker was used to collect pilots' eye movement data when operating landing procedures under different conditions in a simulator. Differences between expert pilots and flight cadets on the vision were analyzed and compared. Results show that before the aircraft passing the threshold, expert pilots scanned the cockpit inside and outside more frequently and faster to form situation recognition in a shorter time. After passing the threshold, expert pilots focused on outside the cockpit to maintain a straight and stable vision ahead; the visual mode was basically along the runway center line, and the line of vision was moderate. Research shows that the introduction of eye tracking technology in pilot training can effectively recognize potential visual errors, and provide an innovative training way for pilot training.

articleTitle: Discrete-time soft sliding mode controller systems with uncertainties by grayscale algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Soft sliding mode control (SSMC) strategy is given for discrete-time systems with uncertainties by the reaching law with active disturbance rejection function in this paper. The reason of causing chattering is analyzed and a discrete reaching law with boundary layer is developed. A grayscale algorithm is presented for uncertainties and the estimates of parameters are obtained appropriately. Soft sliding mode controller is designed by grayscale algorithm. The reaching time is shortened by the proposed strategy. It can drive system trajectories to approach the switching band in finite time and remain on the switching plane. The SSMC system will not be crossed back and forth the switching plane and the chattering is eliminated effectively.

articleTitle: Co-simulation research of closed hydraulic system controlled by servo motor driven constant pump
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A kind of closed hydraulic system controlled by servo motor and constant pump is introduced for controlling the experimental press. By using AMESim and Adams, the hydraulic system model and motion model of the beam of the experimental press are established and co-simulation is carried out. PID controller is used in this hydraulic system to improve the control performance. Simulation results indicate that the position, speed and pressure control of the hydraulic system can meet the design requirements, providing a theoretic basis for the design and debugging of hydraulic system of the actual press.

articleTitle: A study of ground maneuver stability of multiple-bogie undercarriage
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Set up a kinetic analysis model to study ground-maneuver-stability of multiple-bogie undercarriage. The calculations and simulations demonstrate that the allowable nose wheel steering angle and aircraft's ground-maneuver stability could be improved by decreasing height of C.G of aircraft, increasing aircraft's weight, decreasing aircraft's velocity and decreasing engine thrust on condition that aircraft's configuration is identical and aircraft's safety and performance do not reduce.

articleTitle: A review of electromechanical actuation system for more electric aircraft
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The More Electric Aircraft (MEA) emphasizes the utilization of electrical power to replace hydraulic power. And the electromechanical actuation is one of the key technologies for MEA. There are a lot of advantages when electromechanical actuators are used in civil aircraft, such as increasing the efficiency and reducing the take-off weight of aircraft. Furthermore, it also can shorten the production cycle and decrease operation and maintenance costs. So a great many of programs and researches are sponsored and proposed by governments, institutes and industries incessantly. The review in this paper focuses on the researches and application of electromechanical actuation systems using for aerospace and civil aircrafts.

articleTitle: Comprehensive nonlinear modeling and attitude control of a novel tandem ducted fan vehicle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to introduce a complex nonlinear model to a novel tandem ducted fan vehicle which adopted a structure of coaxial rotor and cyclic pitch system, considering aerodynamic coupling, disturbing between the upper and the lower rotor, and special aerodynamic characteristics of duct. On this basis, a robust hover control system has been designed to attitude control using H-infinite static output feedback theory. The results illustrate that the system has good decoupling performance and reveals great ability of attitude tracking as well as disturbance restraint.

articleTitle: A review of powered wheel for aircraft
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: To reduce noise, emission and fuel consumption of aircraft's taxiing at airport, powered wheel on landing gear was investigated experimentally and theoretically. The configurations of powered wheel driven by hydraulic motor and electric motor were proposed historically. Roll friction transmission, gear reducer transmission and direct transmission were adopted. With the global environmental problem and energy crisis being more and more prominent, powered wheel becomes one of the focuses of aviation industry again. This paper reviewed the background, history and current status of powered wheel for aircraft, and summarized its research emphases and development trend. The findings of our work showed that powered wheels for aircraft can reduce noise, emission and fuel consumption of aircraft at airport remarkably, and those driven directly by in-wheel electric motors installed on nose landing gears are the most promising wheels.

articleTitle: Fault detection and isolation based on UKFs for a novel ducted fan UAV
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper presents an online nonlinear actuator fault detection and isolation system, aiming at monitoring monitor the health of a novel ducted fan UAV. In order to cover wider flight envelope, an unscented multiple model adaptive estimation method is introduced as an extension of the EKF-based method. The proposed method provides a bank of UKFs running in parallel, each of which is responsible for completely monitoring corresponding actuator's health. Simulation results shows that locked-in-place and floating faults of the control vanes and failures of the auxiliary ducted fans can be handled with small ambiguity or false detection, rapid response and low computational load, indicating a more efficient operation than EKF-based method. Then, the robustness of the fault detection system is further enhanced by the usage of auxiliary excitation signals.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction model based on contaminant sensitivity for aviation hydraulic piston pump
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In order to realize condition-based maintenance of aircraft and therefore ensure flight safety, it is significant to timely and accurately determine of remaining useful life (RUL) of the aviation hydraulic piston pump. Failure resulting from hydraulic oil contamination is the main failure mode of piston pump, thus a life prediction model based on contaminant sensitivity is established for the aviation hydraulic piston pump in this study. The mathematically explicit relationship between oil contamination and useful life of the piston pump is deduced by utilizing the contaminant sensitivity theory of hydraulic system. The experimental method for measuring contaminant sensitivity of the aviation hydraulic piston pump is proposed based on the contaminant sensitivity model. Useful life of the piston pump under certain contaminant conditions is then predicted utilizing a group of experimental data, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed contaminant-based life prediction model.

articleTitle: Mining actionable combined high utility incremental and associated patterns
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: High Utility Itemsets(HUI) Mining, instead of Frequent Pattern Mining (FIM), has been an attractive theme in data mining domain for over a decade since it can be regarded as an alternative way for researchers to identify actionable patterns. In addition, the necessity of decision-making actions and behavior-oriented strategies based on large amount of informative data impels the significance of discovering actionable patterns to be widely admitted. The current HUIM research focus has been on improving the efficiency to make algorithms faster and more stable. However, the coupling relationships between items in given itemsets are ignored. For example, the utility of one itemset might be lower than the manager expected until one additional item takes part in; and vice versa, the utility of an itemset might drop sharply when another one joins in. What's more, it is not occasional to find out that quite a lot of redundant itemsets sharing the same underlying item are presented based on existing academic HUI mining methods. Store managers would not make expected profits based on such results which makes the results not actionable at all. To this end, here we introduce a new framework for mining actionable patterns, called Mining Utility Associated Patterns (MUAP), which aims to find high utility incremental and strongly associated item/itemset with combined incorporating criteria. The outputs of this algorithm are convincing on real datasets as well as synthetic datasets.

articleTitle: Transient characteristics of an electrothermal anti-icing process based on the improved messinger model
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: An unsteady numerical study on the electrothermal anti-icing process of an aeroengine rotating fairing was performed. The water droplets impingement was firstly simulated based on the Eulerian theory for two-phase flow. Then the calculation method of the convection heat transfer on the fairing surface was proposed and the corresponding code for anti-icing calculation was developed based on the improved Messinger model. The model and method were validated by comparing the present results with those obtained by FLUENT or FENSAP-ICE. System start-up characteristics and effects of rotation were investigated and different heating strategies were compared subsequently. The analysis indicates that rotation can enhance convection heat transfer on the fairing surface; icing and ice shedding phenomenon may appear during the system start-up stage and the response time of the system can be reduced by considering these phenomena; besides, the periodic anti-icing is more energy-efficient compared to the continuous heating when the heating power supply is the same, while when the same energy is consumed by the two patterns, the periodic system shows faster start-up response, but faces the greater risk of icing.

articleTitle: Design and mechanical performance analysis of relief valve with permanent magnet spring
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: To solve the problems of helical compression spring which is easy to fail in using in relief valve, a direct-acting relief valve with permanent magnet spring is designed. The magnetic charge method and finite element models (FEM) are adopted to calculate the magnetic force and design the magnetic spring. The nonlinear model of air gap-magnetic force is established to reveal the impact of different configurations and air gap adjustments on magnetic field distribution. The static and dynamic performances of the relief valve are analyzed by mathematical models and simulations. The results show that the designed valve can meet the technical specification of aerospace servo system. All of these provide an evidence for the study of magnetic components applying in hydraulic system.

articleTitle: An efficient and robust ice accretion code: NUAA-ICE2D
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper describes an icing software toolkit applied to predict the ice accretion layer by layer on the surface of airfoil. Based on modular programming method, this code consists of five separate modules with functions respectively as geometry redefinition, grid generation, airflow calculation, calculation of droplet impingement, and analysis of ice-layer growth. Once the multi-step algorithm is activated, all the modules will be executed automatically and repeatedly controlled by this software until the accumulated icing time is equal to set value. The initial conditions and control parameters can be input via user interface expediently. Some improvements are presented: the fan-shaped partition method used to reconstruct the mesh and update the flow-field locally near the icing region, velocity interpolation based on the local surrounding grid cells, changeable time step used for the calculations of forward motion for droplets, a mesh share used in airflow and ice growth calculations. These new ideas make the icing calculations more quickly, efficiently and stably than before. At last, this code is tested and verified on the NACA 0012 airfoil with rime ice and glaze ice conditions. The available results from NUAA-ICE2D code are compared with that obtained from the experiment and other icing codes.

articleTitle: Effectiveness-based reliability evaluation for equipment network system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The for equipment system of the complex network of command system of special structure and function, respectively from unit layer, sub network layer and network layer extraction reliability evaluation parameters, based on sub network efficiency established perception subnet, accused of subnet and combat the reliability index of the network and maintenance network, and each sub network reliability evaluation model are established using the network analysis method.

articleTitle: A discrete-time nonlinear observer for state of charge estimation of lithium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper presents a novel state of charge (SOC) estimation algorithm for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) using a discrete-time nonlinear observer (DNLO) and a second-order resistor-capacitor (2RC) equivalent circuit model. Considering the hysteresis characteristic of battery, the parameters of the 2RC equivalent circuit model depend on the SOC and the direction of battery current simultaneously. Then the exponential-function fitting method identifies the offline parameters of the battery model. The convergence and stability of the proposed observer is proved by the Lyapunov inequality equation. The performance of the proposed method is also verified by the experiments based on the hybrid pulse power characteristic (HPPC) test. The experiment results show that the proposed observer has better performance in reducing the computation cost, improving the estimation accuracy and enhancing the convergence capability, than the EKF algorithm and the discrete-time sliding mode observer (DSMO) algorithm.

articleTitle: Environmental stress analysis of the aviation hydraulic pipeline effected by the hydraulic pressure
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: China's first self-developed aircraft C919 has been assembly offline. Lacking in the ability to analyze the environmental stress of aviation pipeline will result in less reliability and higher failure rate of aircraft hydraulic system under variable environment conditions. Therefore we have selected a straight pipeline and a bend one of the wing position, and whose environmental stress were analyzed on ABAQUS respectively. Firstly, the article gave the three-dimensional model and provided the relevant parameters. Then mathematical model of straight pipeline and bend pipeline were established with the transfer matrix method. Last but not the least, we have completed straight pipeline stress distribution analysis under different shock pressures and static pressure, analysis of bend pipeline modal and vibration response. The results will support guidelines for research of aviation hydraulic pipeline stress, which also will be significant for the next step with optimal design of aircraft hydraulic pipeline.

articleTitle: Health management for aircraft system using Bayesian probability model
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The health management for aircraft system is difficult problem when the system is rife with nonlinear/non-Gaussian time evolution, the model parameters and sensors measurements are subject to uncertainty, and the diagnosis task suffers from some real-time constrains. This paper discusses the most relatively recent researches about Bayesian probability model, which focuses on the Bayesian networks (BNs), dynamic Bayesian network (DBN) and arithmetic circuit (AC), and then proposes an novel approach to build a robust dynamic arithmetic circuit (DAC) to successfully address this problem. The experiments results show that the DAC, compared with BN, AC and DBN, not only provides reliable online diagnosis under the presence of uncertainty, but also meets the strict time deadlines of health management.

articleTitle: Parametric study of online aero-engine washing systems
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Online aero-engine washing is an advanced way to remove the compressor fouling, which is specified in the AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual). The effect of Aero-engine washing would be influenced by the characterization of liquid sheet. A numerical method is put forward to simulate the motion of liquid drop in the aero-engine when the particles enter into the front of the engine from nozzle. The study includes air flow analysis inside the compressor and the droplets motion calculations injected into the air flow. By changing the inlet pressure and droplet diameter, changes of droplet velocity and motion can be observed. The results shows that the liquid flow in the aero-engine is not effected by the input pressure. Heat and mass of droplets will loss greatly when droplets are in sizes of 50 microns. Conversely, in sizes of 500 microns, droplets can keep their heat and mass well. The results can be used to design the on-line aero-engine washing systems.

articleTitle: Research on the mechanical characteristic of a novel building-block transverse flux permanent-magnetic motor (B-TFPM)
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A novel building-block transverse flux permanent-magnetic motor (B-TFPM) structure was analyzed. The motor stator electromagnets structure is decoupled. Like “building-blocks”, the whole motor is consisted of series elementary blocks. The two features overcome majority TFPMs' shortcomings of complex structures and the difficult manufacture. The motor multi-phase stators are placed in the same circle, which reduces the motor axial size. Therefore it is more suitable for wheel hub driving. The motor mechanical characteristic was deduced based on its voltage and torque equations. Its result indicates the B-TFPM could output big torques at low speed and maintain constant power approximately at high speed, which conform to the electric vehicle (EV) requirement for In-wheel motors. On this basis, a mechanical characteristic adjustment method based on flux-linkages was proposed and the feasibility of this method was verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Structural resonance analysis of EMA servo system with low frequency modal load
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In this paper, a principle of a limit cycle structural resonance is researched, aiming to solve the problem when an Electromechanical Actuator (EMA) Servo System works with a low frequency model load. This paper analyzes a load of an EMA servo system and the load effect modal. An investigation of the way to void the limit cycle structural resonance is proposed, comparing with the experimental results. From the simulation and the test results, this method can enhance the resonance frequency of a load system, and the limit cycle structural resonance will disappear. The dynamic properties of the EMA servo system will be improved efficiently.

articleTitle: Simulation of flow and heat transfer characteristic in the combined thermal and acoustic environment
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A flow and heat transfer model in the combined thermal and acoustic environment was established. The temperature distributions of the test pieces in different heat flux densities with two installation locations of the graphite heater (inside the duct and on the duct) were calculated and analyzed by the CFD method combined with DO radiation model. The results show that the established model can well simulate the flow field and heat transfer in the combined thermal and acoustic environment simulation test-bed. It is shown that the temperature of test piece increases with the increase of the heat flux, but to reach the same temperature, the placement that the heater and the test piece are placed on top surface of the duct requires less heating power, meanwhile the temperature of the test piece has better uniformity. When the heater is placed inside the wind duct, the temperature of the test piece requires heating heat flux 300 kW/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to reach 1000 °C. While when the heater is placed on the duct, the test piece temperature reaches 1000 °C with only 50 kW/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> heat flux density needed. The numerical simulation method and results of flow filed and heat transfer under the combined thermal and acoustic environment in this paper may provide a guidance for building test-beds and setting the parameters of the tests and experiments.

articleTitle: Resonant frequency recognition and tracking for linear oscillating motor under hydraulic load
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Linear oscillating motor attracts considerable focus in industrial applications due to its high efficiency and power density. Despite it has maximum efficiency on its resonant frequency, achieving accurate resonant frequency recognition and tracking is difficult, especially under complicated hydraulic load. In this paper, a novel resonant frequency recognition and tracking strategy is proposed for linear oscillating motor to maintain high efficiency performance. In addition, the influence of hydraulic and nonlinear features of electromagnetic parameters are taken into considerations for frequency prediction. Based on this method, simulations and analysis are conducted for validation, which provides an effective way to enhance efficiency performance of linear oscillating motors.

articleTitle: Research on position control of pneumatic switch valves system based on PWM
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The pneumatic system based on switch valves has many advantages, such as low cost, high performance, easy maintenance, and so on. The pressure fluctuation produced by open and close of the switch valve will impact on the accuracy of pneumatic position system. A new pneumatic system is established containing an asymmetric cylinder and four switch valves. The Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) is used to control the system. Every two valves work together, the work time of valves in each PWM period is adjusted by controlling the duty cycle to control the position of the cylinder's piston. The steady-state duty cycle is defined to improve the stability of the system when the position deviation is zero or less than the error range. The pressure fluctuation is simulated under different duty cycle and frequency, and the steady-state duty cycles are 47.5% and 52.5%. The model of the system is founded with AMESim, and the simulation results show that the stable time is less than 5 seconds, positional error is less than 5%, accordance with the results of experiments.

articleTitle: Design analysis and optimization for the civil aircraft hydraulic supply system based on AMESim
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Hydraulic supply system modeling and simulation has become a critical mean for the civil aircraft hydraulic system design and analysis. Based on AMESim software, hydraulic supply system simulation model was built. And then the whole hydraulic system design process has been simulating analyzed, including system structure and scheme design, hydraulic system and equipments' parameter distribution, and test verification, to assure the most perfect performance of the hydraulic system. AMESim simulation used in the design process from design to test can greatly shorten the developing time and reduce the cost and risk.

articleTitle: The four-chamber hydraulic cylinder
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In the control of traditional hydraulic systems, there will be large pressure fluctuations for the ordinary hydraulic cylinders in the condition of varying load. For this case, we design a four-chamber hydraulic cylinder. By using the hollow rod as another cylinder body, we make two-chamber ordinary hydraulic cylinder into four-chambers. In the control of digital fluid power systems, the number of force values can be obtained by increasing the number of supply pressure to fit the varying load. The results show that the four-chamber hydraulic cylinder can save spaces and costs, improve the working efficiency and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Analysis and study of flux weakening performance in fault-tolerant permanent magnet machine
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The flux weakening performance of fault — tolerant permanent magnet machines are analyzed and studied in this paper. The fault-tolerant permanent magnet machines have high slot leakage inductance and harmonic leakage inductance inherent in order to run safely. The harmonic leakage inductance and the flux-weakening performance of fault-tolerant permanent magnet machines are studied using winding function and FEA. The analytical results find that the fault — tolerant permanent magnet machines can performance flux-weakening very well in little flux-weakening current and can run in wide speed region, as its high harmonic inductance.

articleTitle: Nonlinear path following control of the underactuated AUV via reduced-order LESOs and NTD
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel nonlinear controller for path following control of underactuated autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) in the horizon plane. In order to overcome the drawback of dependence on the accurate dynamic model that are present in a number of path following control strategies described in the literature, the unknown environmental disturbances and unmodeled dynamics are viewed as lumped uncertainties, and reduced-order linear extended state observers (LESOs) are used to estimate and compensate these uncertainties. For handling the problem of computational complexity inherent in the conventional back-stepping method, nonlinear tracking differentiator (NTD) is employed to construct the derivative of virtual control command. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control law is demonstrated through simulations.

articleTitle: Inverter seamless mode tranfer strategy based on H∞ robust control in micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In order to reduce the impact of current and voltage effectively, when the dual-mode inverter grid-connected/off-grid mode transfer in the micro-grid system. There is a uncontrollable parameter perturbations influence in the transfer process of grid-connected/off-grid. This paper presents micro-grid dual-mode inverter which take H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> robust controller in current inner loop, reducing external disturbances and parameter perturbations influence, and enhancing power quality during grid-connected/off-grid mode transfer. Relying on a southern reef stand-alone micro-grid system project, taking simulation and experimental tests, comparative analysis with traditional PI control shows the superiority of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Closed-loop position control of complementary and modular linear flux-switching permanent magnet motor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A high-precision, high-performance motion control system is significant in transportation systems and industrial applications. At present, a new series of complementary and modular linear flux-switching permanent magnet (CMLFSPM) motors with different mover/stator pole pitch ratio have attracted much attention. However, the research about the high-precision position control of these LFSPM motors is absent in literature. Therefore, the closed-loop position control performance of the CMLFPM motor based on mover flux-oriented control is investigated in this paper. The simulation and experiment results validate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategies of the CMLFSPM motor.

articleTitle: Research and development of the simulation platform of the nose wheel with digital steering system based on hardware in the loop
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: With the application of digital fly-by-wire technology in aircraft control, more and more airborne systems have adopted the fly-by-wire control instead of mechanical control. In order to reduce the risk of design, improve design efficiency and reduce design cost, a HILS platform is designed and implemented. The SimCreator software is employed to construct the main frame of the platform, to realize the workflow management, and the simulation models, which are built by Simulink and AMESim software of the main components of the system are also embedded in the platform. The open source flight simulation software FlightGear and other software modules based on the re-development of FlightGear are integrated in the platform to provide a virtual display of nose wheel steering and aircraft tracks. Test results show that the platform runs reliably and stably.

articleTitle: Sending and receiving circuit design for ground-based coherent high-frequency radar
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The sending and receiving circuit is designed in this paper for ground-based coherent high-frequency radar. The system has some functions such as antenna aperture standing wave detection, final-stage power amplifier temperature detection and detection of various power source voltages and currents; it is capable of outputting large standing-wave ratio protection and sending and receiving time sequence protection and detecting overheating, overvoltage and overcurrent, while it can also prevent wrong operations, effectively reduce failures and increase reliability of the whole system; the system can carry out sequential starting through remote control, so that the huge surge impacts brought by simultaneous starting to the power supply grid can be avoided.

articleTitle: An AFDX monitor system introducing data analysis based on ICD
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: An ICD-based avionics bus monitor system for ARINC 664 is developed by using C# and SQL Server. The system builds a model AFDX network based on PXI bus with PXI-C664 card, and invokes functions in DLL files provided by the PXI-C664 board to send and receive data. The monitor tool based on the P/Invoke of WinPcap DLL functions can capture data frame in AFDX network by COTS devices. A database is designed to manage the ICD. Finally, the bus monitor system is used to capture the AFDX data frame and the data is analyzed and interpreted by ICD.

articleTitle: Robust tracking control of medium frequency inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Sampling points in one cycle of 400 Hz inverter are 8 times less than that of 50 Hz inverter, resulting in lower control accuracy and larger static error in 400 Hz power supply system. This paper set up a mathematical model for single-phase solid-static power supply system. The transformer leakage inductance and load can be regarded as uncertainties. A robust controller based on the principle of mixed sensitivity method is proposed to reduce the impact of the uncertainties on output voltage. Simulation and experimental results verify that the robust controller has a superior dynamic performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on the high pressure jet performance of small size nozzle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In the fluidic amplifier of a nozzle-flapper servovalve, the inner flow channel which in a minimized size is under a high pressure condition. The working performance of nozzle plays an important role in the static, dynamic characteristics and the working stability of servovalve. In this article, we focus on the nozzle jet performance, with comparison between CFD simulations and experiment results. Both results prove the initial inlet flow angle and the distance from inlet to outlet influence the jet-flow greatly. Then we provide optimizations of the nozzle design principles in order to improve the performance of fluidic amplifier and the servovalve.

articleTitle: Study on survivability improvement for airframe hydraulic system based on leakage detection and isolation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: External leakage is the main failure mode of airframe hydraulic systems, and which significantly influences the survivability of hydraulic systems. In this paper, the external leakage characteristic of a hydraulic system is described, followed by the analysis methodology of leakage detection. A hydraulic system based on grouping power is proposed, by which the leakage of hydraulic system can be isolated. Finally, experiments have been carried out to verify the research, which show promising results for improving survivability of hydraulic systems based on leakage detection and isolation.

articleTitle: Equivalent sliding mode control for multi-level buck converter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This work describes the design and implementation of the equivalent sliding mode control for Multi-level buck converter in aircraft applications. The multilevel buck converter has been applied in the field of variation of input voltage and high power application, and is a nonlinear system with multi-input, multi-output and strong coupling. This paper designed a strong robust equivalent sliding mode controller for multi-level buck converter to reduce the sensitivity to parameter variations and load disturbances. The detailed design procedure and parameter selection method are presented. Simulation results show that, compared with the PID controller, the multi-level buck converter controlled by the equivalent sliding mode has good dynamic response and stronger robustness under the disturbances in input and output.

articleTitle: Measurement of the AFDX switch latency based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: AFDX (Avionics Full Duplex Switch Ethernet) is an aviation data bus, which is developed on the basis of Ethernet. Whether the data communication is deterministic concerns the airworthiness of AFDX, so this paper discusses the end-to-end delay in AFDX network especially the switch latency. To a great extent, the delay characteristic of the AFDX switch affects the determination of network transmission. We propose an effective and novel scheme based on FPGA, which could measure the switch latency of the specified VLs precisely. By implementing the TDC in FPGA, it could measure the time interval without external GPS time. A measurement system is completely built up and tested. The experimental results show this system has high stability and its accuracy is much higher than 1us.

articleTitle: Inverse dynamic analysis of 6-DOF spindle coupled road load simulators
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: For the inverse dynamic analysis of 6-DOF spindle coupled road load simulator, based on virtual prototype model, the inverse dynamics model is established for the series-parallel hybrid mechanism by using the Newton Euler method. The Aim is to solve the problem when the desired six-dimensional force of rig is known, how to solve the driving forces of the six hydraulic cylinders. The final validation results show that the inverse dynamics model established can accurately describe the dynamic characteristics of the system, which does pave the way for the realization to precise reproduction of six-dimensional random waveform.

articleTitle: Research on pressure control for cascaded atmospheric pressure simulation system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Taking the atmospheric pressure simulation system (APSS) as the research object, the reasons of the pressure control performance degradation of the single-stage APSS affected by the change of working point in low pressure range are analyzed. In order to improve the pressure control performance, the cascaded APSS is proposed instead of the single-stage APSS. Research results show that the proposed cascaded APSS can overcome the shortcoming of the single-stage APSS, and greatly enhance the pressure control performance in the scope of low pressure.

articleTitle: Damage assessment analysis of reconnaissance satellite based on the multi-state fault tree
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: To study the damage problem of reconnaissance satellite under the information countermeasures soft kill conditions, fault tree of satellite performance has been built and destructive level to distinct the degree of the satellite damage has been proposed linked by the satellite reconnaissance information link. Satellite damage assessment based on the multi-state fault tree was proposed and has been applied into some reconnaissance satellite under the conditions of information countermeasures.

articleTitle: Axial piston pump mechanical vibration transmission path and the rear shell sensitivity analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The mechanical vibration transfer path model of the axial piston pump was established for aiming at the aviation hydraulic vibration that it has been more intense with the development trend of high speed and high pressure. In this paper, firstly, based on the first-order trajectory sensitivity method to solve the time-domain sensitivity function curves, the system parameters that have influence on the vibration response of the pump were determined. Secondly, two sensitivity measure indexes were defined to quantitative analysis of the effect that various parameters on the rear shell vibration displacement. We hope that the work in this paper can have some benefit for controlling the aircraft hydraulic system machinery vibration coming from the pump, optimizing the structure of aviation hydraulic pump and promoting the development of domestic large aircraft, providing theoretical and technical basis.

articleTitle: A survey on ergonomics of ATCT in China
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Airport Traffic Control Tower (ATCT) ergonomics determines the humanization design effect of Human Machine Interface (HMI), and the inconsistence of HMI is a leading cause of air traffic controller errors. In this paper, an evaluation index system of ATCT ergonomics is given and applied in China. This survey is useful and helpful for the formulation of unified ATCT ergonomics standards and improving controllers' working conditions in the future.

articleTitle: Thrust fluctuation modeling and its minimization of a double tubular Halbach permanent-magnet motor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper extends an analysis developed for double tubular Halbach permanent-magnet motors to account for the thrust fluctuation associated with the primary design parameters of linear motors. Established by equivalent magnetic circuit method (EMC), the air-gap magnetic field distribution, provides an accurate means of predicting the cogging force that results from end effects. Comparison shows that the analytical model and finite element analysis (FEA) result match well. The analytical model provides an effective means for evaluating the influence of mechanical design parameters on the cogging force waveform, also facilitate its minimization. The employment of slotted core with windings and choosing proper cogging design helps to improve the thrust output.

articleTitle: Research on a new direct drive electro-hydraulic proportional pressure valve for aircraft braking system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Pressure servo valve is usually used to regulate the pressure of the braking actuator to stop the wheel in traditional aircraft anti-skid braking system. The disadvantages of pressure servo valve include complex structure, high production costs, and the requirement for high quality of the hydraulic oil. In addition, its pilot stage is easy to block by contamination and has a constant leakage. This paper proposed a direct drive electro-hydraulic proportional pressure valve which adjust the brake pressure directly with an area-deviation-spool, and studied its application in aircraft braking anti-skid system.
