The mathematical model of this proportional pressure valve is carried out. Then, the dynamic and static characteristics of the direct drive electro-hydraulic proportional pressure valve are analyzed. The application of the valve in the aircraft anti-skid braking system is simulated. This paper simulates aircraft anti-skid braking systems on dry and wet airstrip, and gives simulation results. The simulation results show the feasibility and advantages of using direct drive electro-hydraulic proportional pressure valve in the aircraft anti-skid braking system.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics testing technique on main circuit of aerospace power inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: To improve the design and test of main circuit of aerospace power inverter, a dynamic testing technique is proposed in this paper. Through high speed signal acquisition and isolation, monitoring and evaluating the voltages and currents changing process of main circuit, the design parameters can be optimized based on the testing results which can improve the reliability and electromagnetic compatibility of power inverter.

articleTitle: Modeling and fault analysis of brushless DC motor for electromechanical actuator
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: As the concept of more-electric aircraft is put forward, the power actuation system comes into being. In recent years, the electromechanical actuator system has attracted more and more attention due to the development of the rare-earth permanent magnet brushless DC motor. The Simulink model of Brushless DC motor(BLDCM) was established, the theoretical analysis of the typical BLCDM faults and the fault simulation results of motor windings and power transistor were given.

articleTitle: Electro-hydraulic load simulation method for helicopter booster
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In this paper we present an electro-hydraulic load simulation method for the helicopter booster. Based on electro-hydraulic servo control technology, we construct the load simulation system. And then, the mathematical model of load simulation system for the booster is built. The position servo system controller is combined of hysteresis compensation with PI controller and the force servo system controller is designed by servo-compensation and fuzzy PID controller. Finally, the performance of the proposed elector-hydraulic load simulation method is validated through the position tracking and load simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Mechanism of static characteristics changing of four-way jet-pipe valve due to erosion
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In the working process of a four-way jet-pipe valve, the wedge between the two receiving holes distributes the jet stream into two holes of the receiver, with the stream impinges on the receiver, the wedge gets thinner and radius of the receiving holes get enlarge for long time eroding. Characteristics of the four-way jet-pipe valve changes with the erosion. Mathematical model of is built in detail to analyze the change based on the Bernoulli's equation. By calculation, with the wedge and receiver eroded by jet stream, the receiving flow increases, the pressure recovery just decreases near the null position, the load flow increases, the load pressure decreases,decreases, the flow gain increases and the pressure gain decreases.

articleTitle: Gliding path planning and tracking based on airdropping zone terrain model for precision airdrop system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Autonomous guided airdrop systems based on ram-air parafoils have been addressed to obtain the precision and accuracy of airdropped payload delivery, which has been studied as a two-body system, with flexible structure and 9 degrees of freedom (DOF). The gliding path of parafoil-payload system is directly affected by airdropping zone terrain model, which can be simplified and employed to generate the 3D trajectory. The scheme for tracking the trajectory can be developed to accurately control the lateral-directional yaw angle, which is based on adaptive neural network used to identify online the dynamic error is specified to design the command-tracking controller. It is to demonstrate a simple and effective way of incorporating artificial intelligence into the autonomous control to compensate for system modelling error and external disturbance, which could not only improve the robustness of the system further, but also improve the tracking precision in the process of adaptive parameters converging. Airdrop test results show that the proposed scheme can track the heading angle command with adorable precision.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation for non-involute beveloid gear with intersecting axis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Based on generating cutting method, we set up a mathematical model of the processing of non-involute beveloid gear by shaper cutter enveloping. By describing their coordinate relationships and kinematic constraint conditions, a non-involute beveloid tooth vector equation is obtained using vector transformation. Using the numerical calculation tool, the exterior features of two kinds of beveloid gears are validated. Using the 3D modeling tool, a dynamic simulation is conducted on non-involute beveloid gear pairs with intersecting axes. Results show that the proposed gear pair runs smoothly and the axial play has no impact. It has strong practical value.

articleTitle: RBF Neural Network-based PID controller design for the airborne satellite antenna servo system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Both PID method and RBF Neural Network-based PID method are analyzed for the airborne satellite antenna with stabilization and tracing of a two-axis gimbaled tracker. Based on the neural network scheme, a PID controller was used to control the system. While it can not adapt to the variety of disturbance, and its parameters are difficult to obtain. In this paper, RBF neural network parallel with the PID controller was designed. Compared with the conventional controller, RBF neural network parallel with the PID controller can constantly revise the PID parameters by online learning strategy and improve the stabilization and tracing capability of the system.

articleTitle: An under sampled impact location method based on FBG sensor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: As one of the most critical tasks in structural damage monitoring, real-time impact localization plays the vital role in improving the durability of a structure, especially in the field of aerospace. Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) sensors have been widely applied in composite materials structural health monitoring (SHM) system. This paper proposes a progressive combination recognition algorithm named back propagation-dictionary sparse representation-based classifier (BP-DSRC) to process signals obtained by FBG sensors in Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer composite SHM system, and to accomplish impact localization with higher accuracy. Considering the limited training set in the actual monitoring system, we specifically combine the back propagation (BP) neural network model with which a smaller range of positioning can be divided initially, sparse representation-based classifier (SRC) and K-means singular value decomposition (K-SVD) algorithm. Due to the role of SRC, the positioning effect can be more accurate than the signal matching algorithms. Training dictionary by K-SVD algorithm improves the positioning accuracy of SRC effectively. Meanwhile, considering the relatively low sampling rate of FBG sensors, the average and energy of signal are chosen as the input features of our impact localization algorithm. We implement the algorithm to an actual impact localization monitoring system with composite plate which shows that the proposed localization technique presented is an effective means of estimating impact locations.

articleTitle: Design and validation of hydraulic pump system driven by the electromotor under the high-power and long-time working state in an airborne
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper introduced a type of aircraft electric hydraulic pump system working principle, the key points of the system are analyzed and described, including calculation of boost pressure, system oil temperature control design, environmental temperature checking, starting logic design, the system validation and verification methods are expounded. This system passed through the ground test and flight time Validation, and worked well and reliably.

articleTitle: Design and application of hydraulic pressure system for new fly ash brick
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In response to national policy for energy conservation and emissions reduction which require the appearance of new type of fly ash brick molding machine. Hence, it's exigent to explore substitute for the early brick machine. New type of fly ash brick molding machine is an automatic machine which is used to produce high density bricks with coal ash. It is good for energy saving and environmental protection. In this paper, the system working principle and key points hydraulic systems of the hydraulic brick machine are analyzed, the detail introduction is done for the system validation and verification method. After a certain time of testing and application, the system works well and reliably. Therefore, it has the user's high praises and also has been put into the mass production.

articleTitle: Research on the high sensitive control method for servo system with neural network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A certain guiding system, adopting a servo system based on BLDCM, requires high sensitivity which is hard to reach by general control algorithm. A control method with neural network is proposed in order to meet the request. On the basis of the dual closed-loop, the method compensates the friction torque and adjusts the PID parameters in real time. The simulated and experimental results both show that the sensitivity and performance of the servo system can be improved significantly by this method.

articleTitle: The general design of environment control system based on requirement analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In this paper, Requirement analysis on civil aviation products development and certification are studied. The general design process of environment control system and the related essential factors of requirement analysis are summarized. The solutions are provided to guide requirement analysis for the environmental control system.

articleTitle: Simulation and optimization of a new pulmonary mechanism in electronic oxygen regulator
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The bad controllability of pulmonary mechanism was found during the electronic regulator design, and showed up as the sound of snore along with breathing. The experiment for simplified pulmonary mechanism was carried out and defined that the force unbalance point exists in the pulmonary mechanism. The schematic and working principle of the electronic regulator are shown in the paper. Then the FLUENT software was adopted to simulate the force distribution during the valve opening with different given inlet gage pressure. The pressure, velocity distributions and the driving force are shown in results. Based on analysis results, three aspects can be focused on to develop the valve controllability during the valve opening. Meanwhile the results indicate that the positive correlation between motor thrust and valve opening is unavailable. When the cavity pressure relieves after the valve opens, the valve pressure redistributes. Then the force balance point exists during the pulmonary mechanism valve opening. The analysis shows that increasing the spring stiffness and decreasing the valve pedestal area can improve the problem above. Then the reasonable solution can be obtained through the subsequent experiments. Therefore, in the paper, two accessible modified plans are proposed to optimize the system performance in the following system mechanism modification design.

articleTitle: Design and mode analysis of random vibration test fixture of some airborne heat exchanger
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Each airborne heat exchanger vibration test has very high dynamic performance requirements for the fixture used by it. Mode analysis of some airborne heat exchanger was carried out using the ANSYS software on the basis of the finite element modal analysis method's theory, so as to identify the fixture's natural frequency. In addition, the effectiveness and accuracy of the finite element modal analysis were analyzed through mode testing. The analysis results show that the fixture meets the requirements specified in the Sandia National Laboratory's vibration fixture design specifications, so it ensured that the test was successfully carried out.

articleTitle: Simulation study on the parameters of hydraulic flapper-nozzle valve
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of hydraulic servo control technology, the structural parameters of the hydraulic flapper-nozzle of the water hydraulic servovalves are studied. By theoretical analysis, the simulation conditions of the hydraulic flapper-nozzle valve are confirmed. Simulation method is used to analyze the diameter of nozzle straight tube and the diameter and length of nozzle hole. By comparing the simulation results, the diameter of the straight tube is set as 1.5mm, the diameter of the damping hole is 0.6mm, and the length of the damping hole is 3mm. This paper would fund the base for the design and analysis on the hydraulic flapper-nozzle valve.

articleTitle: The modeling and simulation of distribution of the engine bleed flow
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In this paper the distribution of the engine bleed flow is studied using Flowmaster software. According the simulation, the pneumatic system collocation, difference of the valves, the locations the valves get the feedback pressures and the pressure of air bleeds from the engines all affects the distribution of the engine bleed flow. The imbalance of the flow can be weakened by assuring the consistency of the valves and choosing the proper location the valves get the feedback pressure.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID based digital control technology for aircraft cabin pressure
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The pressure of aircraft cabins is closely related to the flight altitude, flight speed and gas flow of aircraft. To improve comfort and security during flight, pressure and pressure change rate should not only satisfy the requirements of structure but also the demand of aerospace physiology. Therefore, the control system for aircraft cabin pressure is one typical nonlinear time varying system with multitasks and transient response. Reliably, rapidly and stably are the key performances of control system for aircraft cabin pressure. This paper put forward an all-digital control technology for large aircraft cabin pressure. Control algorithm based on fuzzy PID was used and adjusted by rule-based expert systems. Simulation test and ground experiment are presented. The method this paper described can carry out control of aircraft cabin pressure rapidly and stably.

articleTitle: Distributed multisource control of enclosed temperature field based on double closed-loop fuzzy control strategy for salt-fog laboratory
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The goal of heating system in a large-scale salt-fog laboratory is to build a uniform temperature field at a quick pace. Meanwhile, the forced convection is unallowable here because it may affect the uniformity of salt-spray deposition in the salt spray test. For this target and condition constraint, the CFD simulations and experiments of enclosed temperature field model are conducted to explore the rules of the temperature field rising and distributing. Furthermore, a distributed multisource control strategy based on double closed-loop fuzzy controllers is presented for the whole temperature field and pulse width modulation (PWM) control is used to control each single heating plate. Finally, the validity of the control strategy is proved by the experimental tests.

articleTitle: On the development of a landing gear design method in aircraft multidisciplinary design environment
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Landing gear is one of essential airplane subsystems, and the design of landing gear involves structures, weights, the layout of other subsystems and runway design. A landing gear design method is under development to be integrated within the MDO framework in-house developed by Shanghai Aircraft Design and Research Institute. The landing gear design considerations and analysis modules are reviewed and discussed, such as landing gear layout, tire selection, Aircraft Classification Number and water spray pattern. Finally the landing gear design of a regional aircraft is given as a design case.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of electromechanical co-simulation for airborne gravimeter stable platform
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The Airborne Gravimeter is a precision instrument for measure of the earth's gravity, in order to make the gravimeter isolate all kinds of disturbances in flight, and always keep an upright and stable state. In this paper, a high accuracy Airborne Gravimeter inertial stable platform was designed for this purpose. Also in order to shorten the design cycle of stable platform and ensure the performance of the structural design of stable platform system can satisfy the design requirements, the electromechanical co-simulation was built of high accuracy Airborne Gravimeter stable platform in this paper, and this electromechanical co-simulation model based on Adams and MATLAB. The time domain and frequency domain characteristics of the electromechanical co-simulation model was simulated and analyzed, then the simulation results and experimental results were compared. The results show that under the conditions of open loop, the simulation results of time domain and frequency domain approximately agree with experimental results. This result verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the simulation model. So that this model can be used in the stage of structural design to predict characteristics of the stable platform and then improve design efficiency.

articleTitle: A lightweight electromechanical actuation system with fast response
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Under the background of MEA (More Electric Aircraft), electromechanical actuation system is widely applied in aircraft. A light-weight electromechanical actuation system with fast response and high power density is designed and developed according to the limited space and high level disturbance moment. The following three points are introduced in this paper: (1) the lockable electromechanical actuation system; (2) design and simulation of the electromechanical actuation system; (3) tests of the electromechanical actuation system.

articleTitle: Study on bionic attitude transformation of free-floating space robot
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Double rigid bodies bending theory model of a free-falling cat's twist has been widely accepted. A 3-DOF hinge joint model is designed through the further analysis of this model, which realizes the attitude transformation of a free-floating space robot under the condition of weightlessness. Based on linear momentum and angular momentum conservation principle, general kinematics model of the space robot was established in this study, and the algorithm that is available for MATLAB analysis was proposed according to the kinematics model. And the paper had a kinematics analysis of the 3-DOF hinge joint model which was proved to be correct. Besides, the paper studied the influence on attitude transformation of structure parameters when the structure was symmetrical or asymmetrical, and the best bending angle method was brought up to achieve the disturbance-accuracy-required attitude transformation of asymmetrical structure.

articleTitle: Energy recovery of testing bed for high speed hydraulic pumps
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Generally in the hydraulic pump testing system, the pump is driven by the electric motor and the load is the throttle valve. However, this layout may lead to two problems for the high speed pump. One concern is the large amount of the power loss at orifices of the valve. The other is that the speed of electric motor can not satisfy the pump. To solve these problems, an energy recovery scheme for the testing system is proposed in this paper. The pump is driven by a pass-axis hydraulic motor, connected with another hydraulic motor which is in the return line. The two motors and pump are coaxial and connected by couplings. In this way, hydraulic energy can be recovered and utilized to drive the hydraulic pump. To verify the feasibility of this method, the simulation model is built in the software AMESim. Simulation results show that the proposed energy saving system is effective.

articleTitle: A brief analysis of landing gear overspeed protection design
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: To prevent flight crew from retracting or extending landing gear by mistake when aircraft is overspeed, set up a set of requirements according to relevant airworthiness regulations. Take some airplane as an example, the landing gear overspeed protection design could efficiently prevent flight crew from overspeed retracting or extending landing gear, though the safety requirement for the landing gear safety valve is too high. After an optimization, the landing gear system's error prevention performance is identical, landing gear system safety and reliability are improved and the cost of landing gear is reduced.

articleTitle: Influence of convergent-divergent structure on the multiphase flow behavior
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The Multiphase flow behavior in an oil production pipe with the convergent-divergent structure is analyzed via computational flow dynamics (CFD) methodology. Based on the mechanism of flow-structure interaction, the location undergoes the high risk of erosion-corrosion is predicted and then the structural improvement for the pipe is proposed. The results showed that the maximum wall shear stress and oil phase fraction both locate approximately 38 mm away from the end of convergent structure. The numerical prediction agrees well with the actual failure instance. It is also found that if the conjunction structure is changed from the right angle to the 1:4 chamfer, the vortex region is eliminated. Accordingly, the maximum wall shear stress is reduced to lower than the critical value of carbon steel. As a result, the erosion-corrosion caused by multiphase flow may be prevented and the operation reliability of the pipe is improved.

articleTitle: The design of the integrated jet-pipe servo-valve with high reliability
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper describes the design of the integrated jet-pipe servo-valve with high reliability, including the design scheme, the dynamic sealing structure for pistons, the structure design and optimization for hydrodynamic force compensation, the key indicators and parameters calculation, simulation and experimental verification. According to the large valve port opening size, mechanical operability of the single valve, the corresponding solutions are provided. The results of simulation and experiment show that the design of the integrated jet-pipe servo-valve with high reliability is reasonable and practical and can meet the requirements of the design.

articleTitle: Experiment investigation of hot-air anti-icing structure of engine inlet vane
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A novel hot-air anti-icing structure of engine inlet vane is put forward and anti-icing experiment is conducted in a small open-circuit icing wind tunnel. The structure is combined with impinging jet, micro channels, and exhaust releasing exhausted hot air to sweep running-back water off the coating. The experiment is run at different simulated meteorological and bleed air conditions. The vane surface temperature and running-back water film distributions of two kinds of micro channel with channel spacing of 1.5 mm and 2 mm are obtained. The results indicate that impinging jet ensures the anti-icing effect of leading edge, smaller interval of micro channels brings better anti-icing effect at same bleed air condition, and temperature of bleed air has more influence than pressure. The vented out exhausted air protects the rear skin from running-back water icing effectively.

articleTitle: The design and simulation analysis of a rotary valve based on FLUENT
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In order to realize the functional requirements of hydraulic cylinder installing in the leg of the rehabilitation robots, a new type of servo rotary valve was designed with an introduction of its structure. The spool in rotary valve may have different locations when the actual working conditions are different. To know the flow field of rotary valve above case we have done a thorough numerical analysis. In the next step the basic theory of the numerical simulation, including the modeling, meshing and parameterization, is explained. The research of the flow field in rotary valve is treated in detail by using a fluid dynamics simulation tool, FLUENT. And through simulation the results including the pressure of internal flow, velocity distribution and the flow coefficient characteristic curve of the valve with various opening degree were obtained. Besides, we also drew the curves of pressure and velocity differences, and found the main reasons for the energy loss through the valve under different conditions, which could provide a theoretical basis for structure optimization of the rotary valve, motor selection or even an experimental instruction of the rehabilitation robot later.

articleTitle: Functional modeling method and its application in hydraulic system performance and fault analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper introduces a simulation and modeling method for hydraulic systems, with a focus on system performance and fault analysis. In a first part, the concept and need for functional modeling are introduced. In a second part, this paper analyzes the difference between functional modeling and detailed modeling, and introduces the process of hierarchical simulation based on functional modeling. Finally, engineering applications for the functional modeling method in hydraulic system performance and fault analysis is discussed. The feasibility and accuracy of the functional modeling method is investigated.

articleTitle: Analysis on the flow requirement of an aircraft hydraulic energy system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The composition and working principle of an aircraft hydraulic energy system were introduced, the flow and pressure requirements of hydraulic users was analyzed by combining with the normal condition for each phase of flight missions, and the selection design of main components of the pump source was completed. The flow and pressure in line with supply and demand of the hydraulic system under the normal condition was analyzed, for the subsequent design and demonstration test of aircraft hydraulic energy system provides a theoretical reference.

articleTitle: The research about peak voltage suppression technique of direct current (DC) torque motor with large inductance that applies the pulse width modulation (PWM) control method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high peak voltage at two ends of direct current (DC) torque motor with large inductance that during the pulse width modulation (PWM) control process, the original H-bridge PWM control method, the current flow and the main reason of peak voltage have also been analyzed. Based on the analysis, a new H-bridge PWM control method has also been advanced and undertaken the contrast experiment by a self-build experimental platform. According to the results, the new PWM control method can reduce the peak voltage that between the motor ends' significantly.

articleTitle: Influence of stator parameters on output performance of linear switched reluctance motor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper studies the influence of stator's various parameters of longitudinal linear switched reluctance motor (LSRM) on tangential force and magnetic field strength. A series of typical candidates are applied to these parameters analyzed. The proposed LSRM configurations are compared by using two dimensional finite element analysis (FEA). And then we change the parameters of the initial to improve its performance. The propulsion force of FEA result shows that this model saves material at the loss of only 1.83% of force. And the research is instructive and meaningful to the production of the stators.

articleTitle: Research on the friction characteristics of pneumatic cylinder couples based on ultrasonic friction reduction
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The effect of ultrasonic friction reduction (UFR) has been found for a few decades and been applied in a series of fields, like mechanical design and manufacturing. Meanwhile it has also been successfully involved in pneumatic cylinders of pneumatic field. This research proposed an equivalent method for the seal-cylinder couple to be unfolded into a rubber bar-steel plate friction couple, in order to help study the frictional condition between pneumatic cylinder friction couple. A friction measurement system was established aiming at the equivalent friction couple and the influence of sealing ring diameter, normal force and input voltage of ultrasonic vibrator on friction reduction effect were discussed.

articleTitle: Comparative investigation on tribological properties and surface morphologies of glass fiber-epoxy resin composite with nonsmooth surface under natural seawater lubrication
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: For comparing the tribological properties of glass fiber-epoxy resin composite (GF/EPR) with smooth and Nonsmooth surface against stainless steel 316L under natural seawater lubrication, wear tests were conducted on a ring on disc test rig with load of 60N and rotational speed of 600, 800, 1000, 1200 and 1400 r/min. The corresponding CFD simulations were carried out after the test. The test results show that, compared with GF/EPR with smooth surface, GF/EPR with nonsmooth surface shows a reduction of the friction coefficients and the largest reduction is 63.04% at 1000 r/min. And the CFD results support the test conclusions. Moreover, it is observed that the roughness of 316L has a significant decline after wear test, but the roughness of GF/EPR displays an obvious increase.

articleTitle: A new method to analyze resistance circuit
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This article gives a brand new way to analyze circuit. Traditionally, people use equations to analyze electric circuit. Solving equation group cannot show the inner relationship of the circuit easily. This article tries to analyze circuit with diagram, which is more intuitive and more efficient. It's so efficient that sometime there is nearly no need to calculate any equations any more.

articleTitle: The technology of mixed gas detection in fuel tank based on tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Aircraft fuel tank fuel explosion is a threat to aviation safety is one of the main factors. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) recently to the airworthiness regulations was revised, the provisions of the aircraft fuel tank in the upper space of oxygen content, in order to ensure the safety of flight. This paper analyses the aircraft fuel tank mixed gas combustion causes general fuel inerting system are introduced. And for the lack of real-time detection of oxygen shortcomings, introduces a kind of non contact of the mixed gas detection technology. Through simulation and preliminary exploration of the feasibility of the technique.

articleTitle: Force characteristics test system for high temperature electromagnetic actuators
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: To meet the force characteristics test for electromagnetic actuator under high temperature, a force characteristics test system for high temperature electromagnetic actuators is presented. In this paper, the structure of the system are introduced and the thermal finite element model of the system are established. The influences of the screw joint and the structure parameters of heat insulation component on the temperature variation of test platform are analyzed based on the simulation results, and the structure parameters of thermal insulation material suit for high temperature testing are also presented. The heat stress caused by the temperature variation is simulated. The force characteristics test system for high temperature electromagnetic actuators is established and the experimental investigations of the high temperature actuator are processed. The experimental results indicate that the test system proposed in this paper can accomplish the measurement for high temperature electromagnetic actuator at 280 °C.

articleTitle: Adaptive three-dimensional guidance law based on neural dynamic surface control
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Considering the three-dimensional(3D) terminal guidance issue, based on the neural dynamic surface control theory, a novel guidance law is designed, and its stability has been proved by Lyapunov stability criterion. The radial basis function(RBF) neural networks are used to estimate the target motion information in real-time and reduce the coupling interference in the 3D motion model. Thus the guidance law can be self-adaptive to the variation of parameters, which improved its robustness. Simulation results shows that the missile which uses this guidance law can obtain smaller miss distance in the case of target maneuvering complicated.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of two-dimension unsteady flow field in aircraft pneumatic system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The two dimensions model of aircraft pneumatic system with constant volume tank is established, the model includes constant volume tank, orifice and pipe. The heat transfer among the air inside the pneumatic system, pneumatic components and air outside the pneumatic system is involved in the simulation. The two dimensions unsteady flow field in charging and discharging tank is calculated. After charging and discharging, the temperature of components in the system is different, the lowest temperature is the orifice's surface temperature. With the method displaced in this article, the two dimensions flow field in pneumatic system can be obtained.

articleTitle: Moisture prediction for civil aircraft cabin
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Relative humidity level affects cabin comfort of civil aircraft. In this paper, a prediction method of relative humidity was developed based on a well-mixed zonal model. To improve the prediction accuracy, a Lumped Virtual Moisture Source (LVMS) and its two-node moisture transfer model were established to describe a moisture desorption-absorption process of the total of interiors materials in a simple way. The conception of lumped moisture capacity and lumped moisture resistance was firstly introduced to represent moisture storage capability and moisture transfer resistance for the total interior materials. A parameter identification procedure was further presented to obtain these two model parameters of LVMS for different types of civil aircrafts using measured data onboard. Cabin environmental measurements were carried out in five types of civil aircrafts. Compared with continuously measured data during flight, the method to predict the cabin relative humidity can adapt to different types of aircrafts and agree with measured data well. This study may provide some help to develop a reasonable humidity control strategy and suggest proper water storage of humidifier.

articleTitle: Investigation into influence factors of synchronous movement of multi-cylinders
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Seal is one of the most important characteristics for cylinders and suitable seal configuration will guarantee the long life cycle of the seal and the cylinder. Experiment is the only way which can demonstrate the best seal configuration in applications. In this paper, one approach is brought forward for testing the seal performance of cylinders with different seals configurations at the same load working condition for saving the test time. In the test-rig, the synchronization of cylinders is one of the key technologies. The test system is modelled in the AMESim software. The effect caused by the changes of the different physical parameters is analyzed, such as load stiffness, viscous damping coefficient of cylinder, dead volume of cylinder and internal leakage coefficient. The experiment is carried out and test results agree with the simulation results. Finally, the appropriate solution is proposed for improving the synchronization of the multi-cylinders further.

articleTitle: Eye movement comparison of professional and novice pilots in key actions of takeoff phase
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In order to make up the drawback of traditional skill assessment that is too subjective, the eye tracking has already been applied to various fields. Based on research on eye movement of flying skills, it is found that the average fixation time and eye moving trace of professional pilot varies from that of novice. It is still unclear the changes in eye movement data during key actions after improvement of flight control skill. For the purpose of further understanding these changes, the thesis takes the takeoff phase as the simulated flight mission and makes rules for assessing performance level with speed, heading, bank and pitch angle as parameters by referring to the practice test standard so as to grade simulated flight of pilots. Students and professional pilots are recruited as subjects for the test. Then correlation analysis carried on their performances and fixation count, fixation point percentage, total fixation time, fixation time percentage and average fixation time respectively. The results show that pilots' performances are related to the fixation count greatly. In the comparison of subjects in key actions of take-off, it is found the drawbacks of students in attention allocation and information extraction. These founding can provide a detailed guideline in training of flight cadets.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional simulation of impingement jet flow and heat transfer with various working fluids
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The working fluid plays an important role in the flow and heat transfer performance of impingement jet. Though a lot of fluids such as air, water and oil, have been widely used in jet applications, there lack research works focus on the impacts of fluid properties on the overall heat transfer performance. This paper made comprehensive comparisons of five jet fluids (air, helium, water, FC-77 and MIL-7808) with different thermal properties. The Prandtl number in the present investigation covered a range of 0.67~342.5. The thermal performance of these fluids were tested by using a three-dimensional impingement jet model. Firstly, this computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model was validated by comparing the simulation results with previous experimental data. The variation of local Nusselt number was interpreted based on the numerical results. Then Nusselt number obtained from different jet fluids were presented in detail. Results indicated that the Nusselt number is strongly dependent on the fluid Prandtl number. Finally, the cooling performance of these fluids was evaluated basing on the present jet configuration. The advantages and disadvantages of these working fluids were discussed from the practical application viewpoint. In particular, we suggest that the helium-jet scheme with the merits of high heat transfer efficiency and high practicality is worth spreading.

articleTitle: Research on the application of membrane separation technology in onboard inert gas generating system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: With the rapid development of membrane separation technology, domestic aircrafts start to use the technology in OBIGGS for preventing undersired ignition and explosion. This article talks about the mechanism of membrane separation as well as the performance of separated membrane (membrane material, membrane fabrication technology and membrane separation module) in the membrane separation technology. With some researches and experiments on the application of membrane separation technology in OBIGGS, the article concludes some useful experiences, and promotes the use of membrane separation technology in OBIGGS.

articleTitle: Study on turbine blade fractures of some cooling turbine
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Turbine blade fractures of some cooling turbine was analyzed and judged to be incurred by high-cycle fatigue. Through using the finite element method, the natural frequencies of its blades were analyzed, and their natural frequencies of the first 20 orders were obtained under the action of centrifugal load. The computational fluid dynamics simulation was used to identify the unsteady aerodynamic load applied on the blade under the typical conditions. The fast fourier transform was carried out to identify the main frequency of the unsteady aerodynamic load. A Campbell diagram analysis was carried out so as to show that blade resonance occurs to the turbine impeller wheel if its speed is at 55000r/min or 72000r/min. Resonance points can be effectively evaded if the structures of the blades are improved to dramatically increase their natural frequencies. The test result proves that the improvement measures are effective.

articleTitle: Study on accelerated life testing method for air turbine starter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Study on accelerated life test scheme is conducted according to the life test load spectrum of a certain type of air turbine starter. Through comparison and analysis of the failure modes and durability simulation results of the air turbine starter, the study identifies the main component failure mechanism of the air turbine starter. Based on the failure mechanism derived from analysis, and with the Miner accumulated damage theory, the mathematical model for two accelerated life tests involving increasing torque load and extending high-rotation-speed dwell time is developed. The equivalent acceleration coefficient is determined by computation, and the program of carrying out the accelerated life test on the basis of the existing test conditions is developed. According to the analysis results, this accelerated life test program is feasible and could provide a basis for the life design and test schedule development of the air turbine starter.

articleTitle: Electro-hydraulic control system and frequency analysis for a hydraulically driven six-legged robot
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper presents a methodical design of the electro-hydraulic control system for a large scale hydraulically driven six-legged robot, which can walk on rough terrain. Considering the widely varying load during the locomotion cycles, the electro-hydraulic control system should be capable of effectively handling widely varying load and possess high control bandwidth. To address these issues, a two-stage and distributed control architecture is presented. The co-simulation framework is fabricated by the interface technology integrating Simulink, AMESim and ADAMS, in order to build the total dynamics modeling. Subsequently, the design of power system and numerical evaluation of frequency analysis are implemented. Finally, verification tests were conducted in the outdoor environment to prove the effectiveness of the proposed design.

articleTitle: The reliability model of the lunar samples storage installation based on GSPN
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The traditional reliability model is difficult to describe the dynamic behavior and the aging process of the lunar samples storage installation system with the dynamic time serial processes such as the fault detection, the fault recovery, the system aging and so on. Aiming at this problem, this paper uses the generalized stochastic Petri net to establish the reliability model of the lunar samples storage installation system. By using this model, the effects of the system aging rate, the false alarm rate and the fault detection coverage of the measurement and control system on the system reliability are analyzed in detail. Analysis results show that there is also a potential fault condition and a fatal danger condition in the lunar sample storage installation system in addition to the perfect condition and the normal fault condition due to the influence of the false alarm rate and the fault detection coverage of the measurement and control system. The actual design of the lunar samples storage installation system should be rationally allocated system reliability parameters and achieve the probability of the fatal danger condition of lunar samples storage installation system as small as possible and the reliability of the system to reach 0.9999.

articleTitle: Study on bypass overflow characteristic of turbopump pressure regulating system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Bypass valve is a common pressure protector in adjustable pressurization system. Its characteristic parameters directly influence the operating pressure and operation safety of such system. By AMESim system simulation platform, the paper establishes a model for turbopump and its pressure regulating system, makes characteristic description of key components in the system, studies and analyzes the influence of physical parameter, adjustable degree of opening and other characteristic parameters of bypass valve on turbopump output characteristic, system pressure and flow. The findings show that bypass valve, in the case of turbine speed regulating failure, can effectively drop system pressure, reduce turbopump speed and control system flow, and its parameter regulating capacity intensifies with the increase of diameter of bypass valve. The study provides reference for other aircraft fuel bypass valve design and system safety design.

articleTitle: Aircraft bearing life reliability design and analysis under multiple distributed loads with AFSOM method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Accurate design and calculation of the aircraft bearing life reliability have the significant importance for the reliability design of the aviation subsystem components. This paper proposes a new method for solution of the bearing life reliability by AFSOM method under considering load fluctuation. When the bearing life reliability is between 0.4 and 0.9, the bearing reliable life obeys the two parameter Weibull distribution; According to that, the relationship between the bearing life reliability and the reliable life correction coefficient is established. When the bearing life reliability is between 0.9 and 1, the function is established based on the curve fitting. By considering the load fluctuation, reliable life correction coefficient and the limit state equation of bearing life reliability, it can solve the bearing life reliability through the AFSOM method. This method is easy and reasonable, highly reliable and suitable for engineering application.

articleTitle: Novel design and kinematics modeling for delta robot with improved end effector
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A improved delta robot with a novel transmission mechanism to reduce abrasion and a new configuration of end effector is proposed in this paper. Specifically, the traditional telescopic chain which employs prismatic pair is replaced by parallel mechanism with four rods hinged. The frication in the connection can be significantly decreased. The motor that drives the telescopic chin is fixed on the base so that the moving platform can reach high speed and high acceleration. As for end effector, it is designed as mechanical claws based on the principle of plane thread. This structure makes it better adapted to multifarious shapes of load. Moreover, the rigidity and the stability of the end effector are distinctly improved. In addition, the analysis of kinematics including inverse kinematics and direct kinematics is conducted on the simplified system. The analytical results are validated by the co-simulation that combines ADAMS with MATLAB. The study of the kinematics is the solid foundation for parameters optimization and further control.

articleTitle: Design and performance study on electromagnetic microvalve
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: An electromagnetic microvalve which can be used in pneumatic pressure control for lab-on-a-chip applications is presented and its structure, working principle, and encapsulation process with valve body fabricated by using polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) are provided. The numerical simulation of flow filed under several opening degrees of the microvalve is made by software Fluent with UDF Function, and its velocity, pressure, and outlet flow flux under different opening degrees of the electromagnetic microvalve are got. Experimental study of its performance is done under different actuated pressures, frequencies, duty cycles. Influencing factors of the average flow and transient flow under On-Off model and PWM model are analyzed, and its theoretical reason are given. Results show that the designed electromagnetic microvalve has the advantages of fast response time, low-cost, high precision and can be easily integrated with pneumatic microfluidic chips. The results are helpful for the improvement of integration and control accuracy of microfluidic chips.

articleTitle: Experimental study on spool pair characteristics of servo valves
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Since the characteristics of the servo valve's spool valve pair are difficult to grasp, this paper proposes methods of testing the internal characteristics parameters of the spool pair under variable temperature conditions. Based on these methods, a series of testing systems are designed and test platforms are built, which can measure the viscous damping coefficient, coulomb friction, hydrodynamic and discharge coefficient under different high temperature conditions. The testing results could be used to offer references for the design and manufacture of the spool pair.

articleTitle: Research on the architecture of auxiliary energy system for future fighter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: By consulting the foreign literature about the development trend of future fighters, it has been understood that future fighters have some advantages or absolute advantages in flight envelope, flight, maneuverability, stealth characteristics, weapon effectiveness, network intelligence, etc., thereby having typical capability characteristics such as more comprehensive stealth capability, wider combat scope, stronger situational awareness capability, more excellent airborne weapons, etc. The combat scope of future fighters is expanded and they may be equipped with directed energy weapons, so there are stricter requirements for the function and performance of the auxiliary power system, traditional auxiliary power systems will fail to meet the requirements, and it is urgently needed to optimize structure, reduce weight and cost, improve performance and reliability and develop towards the direction of high structure integration and high energy integration. On the basis of introducing traditional auxiliary power systems, this paper further describes the composition and operating principle of more electric integrated power unit, adaptive thermal management system, etc. Through analysis and comparison of different auxiliary energy systems, the development direction of the auxiliary energy system for future fighters has been obtained.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of the heat insulating structure for the equipment loading in the hypersonic vehicle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: To avoid the poor working ability of the equipment loading in the hypersonic vehicle caused by the aerodynamic heating, a heat insulating structure for the equipment was designed. Applying the quartz lamp heating system to imitate the high-temperature aerodynamic heating environment, the reliability of the heat insulating structure was tested. And the temperature results of the key points in the structure were found secure for the equipment. There were three other experiments conducted to compare with the former test, including bringing the heat insulating materials out of the structure, replacing the heat insulating materials by sticking the aluminum foils on the surfaces of the main structure and removing the screws. The results showed that heat insulating materials played an important role in reducing the heat transfer and the thermal contact resistance had a remarkable effect on the final temperature. However, the aluminum foil was not such useful to prevent heat transfer in the high-temperature environment.

articleTitle: The muti-sensors surveillance system based on remote network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: This paper establishes a multi-sensors intelligent surveillance system, using Adaptive Boost(Adaboost) as classifier and embedded Linux system as platform. Since normal monitoring systems have single function, DS18B20 digital temperature thermometer is added into system to capture more data. TCP/IP protocol is used for remote data transmission. Adaboost algorithm is applied to detect people entrance. This design improves the intelligence of monitoring system and can be widely used in fire-prevention, safety system and so on.

articleTitle: Influence of pre-orifice on static characteristic of ball bearing
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A simulation model was developed to study static characteristic of ball bearing with annular orifices. The influence of pre-orifice diameter was discussed through simulation analysis. Simulation results show that for constant supply upstream pressure, the larger pre-orifice diameter is the larger volumetric flow rate of pre-orifice is; and for constant pre-orifice diameter, relation between volumetric flow rate and supply upstream pressure is nearly proportional when upstream pressure is larger than some critical pressure value. And a pressure and flow rate measurement system was established to carry out the experiments of how pre-orifice diameter affects the pressure and volumetric flow rate to verify the simulations; it was revealed that the experimental results were in agreement with the simulation results. This research will contribute to some relative investigations on the design of ball bearing system.

articleTitle: AC asynchronous motor control system based on speed sensor-less
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Vector control needs motor speed as feedback information in a real time. Encoders are used for speed identification usually, but some severe industrial situations limit the usage of encoders. As a result, scientists begin to find speed identification methods. After scrutinizing the advantages and disadvantages of the main motor control system and motor speed identification methods, we make up the plan of Speed Sensor-less vector control based on model reference adaptive system(MRAS). Specific to MRAS speed identification methods, the paper analyzes the shortcomings of MRAS model based on rotor flux and puts forward the compensation measurement. Eventually, simulations of the improvement on MRAS, estimated speed based on MRAS and the vector control system have been done, and the paper shows the results of the simulations.

articleTitle: A dynamic node thermal analysis method of fuel tank based on Sinda/Fluint software
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Since fuel has been an important heat sink to high speed aircraft, the dynamic thermal analysis of the fuel tank is of more great significance. Relative to some published simulation methods, we tried the dynamic node thermal network analysis method with two new concepts of the twinned tanks and the HTP tie on Sinda/Fluint software to solve the two-phase heat transfer problem caused by the liquid level drops. The compared results to the VOF method on Fluent software for a typical fuel tank problem showed that the method used in this paper can obtain a fairly accurate results and improve the calculation efficiency greatly at the same time.

articleTitle: Kinematic analysis of 6-DOF spindle-coupled road simulators
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The 6-DOF spindle-coupled road simulators are complicated serioparallel mechanisms. In this paper, the constraint equations about the length of major components are established based on the constrained relationships of different space vectors. Under the premise that the structural parameters and movement rule of the test rig are given, the position and the velocity of the simulator are analyzed. The Jocabian matrix is derived based on the Generalized separation of variables. The validity of the kinematical analysis is verified based on the co-simulation in ADAMS and Matlab.

articleTitle: The controller design of phase-lock loop based on the least-squares method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Some literatures propose the PI controller design method of phase-lock loop (PLL) that without the lowpass filter, and the design rule is easy since the PLL is a second-order system. However, the PLL with the lowpass filter is a high-order system, and the PI controller design is complicated according to traditional method. This paper proposes a new method to design the PI controller parameters of PLL based on the least-squares method. It analyzes the input sensitivity matrix and output sensitivity matrix of the simplified synchronous reference frame phase-lock loop (SRF-PLL) based on robust theory, and points out the problem of PI controller design based on the pole placement method. As for the three equations consisted of proportional gain and integral gain, this paper takes it as a linear regression model and uses the least-squares method to estimate the optimal proportional gain and integral gain. Under different adverse conditions, the performances of the PI controller designed by the proposed method are tested through simulation, and the simulation results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Braking technique on dual-redundancy differential actuation system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The quick-acting braking is one of the key techniques on dual-redundancy differential actuation system. The permanent magnet brake becomes the preferred option for the dual-redundancy differential actuation system, because of its excellent safety and quick repercussion. The braking and switching mechanism on dual-redundancy differential actuation system is analyzed to identify the influence factors of braking time. The mathematical expressions of the electric response time, armature pull-in time and friction braking time are derived respectively. Based on rigid body dynamics, the kinetic equation of dual-redundancy differential actuation system is derived. Furthermore, the key technologies of the permanent magnetic brake are studied, such as the sliding friction, permanent magnetic force and performance evaluation. The relationship between the micro-gap of brake pair and the permanent magnetic force loss is studied. The verification tests of sliding friction coefficient, permanent magnetic force and emergency braking are designed and accomplished, and the results illustrate the rationality of the analysis. At last, some critical technical issues deserving further research are also pointed out.

articleTitle: A study on basic copper nitrate as catalyst for 5AT/Sr (NO3)2 propellant
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The effects of basic copper nitrate (BCN) on combustion characteristics of solid propellants composed of 5AT/Sr(NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are examined. Thermodynamic theoretical calculation was conducted, it was indicated that the addition of BCN to 5AT/Sr(NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixture is acceptable to reducing the adiabatic combustion temperature and enhancing the gas output. Closed bomb test was adopted to measuring the linear burning rate, the results showed that adding BCN to 5AT/Sr(NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixture can improve the their combustion characteristics.

articleTitle: Researching on stability of rocket ejection seat
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The paper presents the theoretical analysis and simulation verification on the effects of the three kinds of stabilized techniques, which include the drogue chute, the stabilization fins and the stabilization booms, to stabilize the ejection seat. The stability effects are evaluated through testing the stability performance of the seat according to the parameters of the three-axial angular velocity and Multi-axial Dynamic Response Index (MDRI). As the simulation results shown, the drag performance of the drogue chute, the deployable area of the stabilization fins and the length of the stabilization booms are the critical parameters to measure the stability of the seat. The research results in the paper, which has comparatively theoretical and practical value, will provide a theoretical basis for the selection of the stabilized devices of the new generation rocket ejection seat.

articleTitle: A 12-pulse current source converter based on autotransformer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: According to the principle of DC injection, the topology of a 12-pulse current source converter based on autotransformer is proposed. The Main bridge topology is a autotransformer, and each injection branch consists of a double winding reactor and a IGBT and a diode in series. DC injection could make the main bridge realize zero current switching and operate in four quadrants. The system control method is presented on 9-level topology. The simulation based on MATLAB shows that the topology has good characteristic. Compared with traditional current source converter, the novel topology solves the problem of high THD in traditional 12-pulse converter, and reduces the system volume and capacity efficiently. Moreover it applies to the high-power field.

articleTitle: The analysis of a kind of modularization transverse flux motor used in electrical vehicle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to analyze a kind of modularization transverse flux motor (MTFM) and compare it with ordinary motors. The basic principle and control method of this motor have been discussed in this paper. And the simulation results of the motor's basic unit have been presented and analyzed, the benefits of the modularization structure also been concluded. The requirements of the motor used in an electrical vehicle (EV) was proposed. To satisfy the requirements an induction motor (IM), a switched reluctance motor (SRM), a permanent magnet motor (PMSM) and a MTFM were designed. Then, simulation results and control method of the four motors were discussed and compared. The paper reports the results of the design and simulation results of the MTFM and four motors which meet the same requirements were compared with it. The results show that, the MTFM can achieve a relatively higher power density than other four motors and it is very light which relatively suit the EV application.

articleTitle: Medium frequency power supply system based on dynamic voltage restorer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: The fundamental frequency of the 400Hz power supply system is 8 times 50 Hz one, so the line voltage drop becomes a severe problem that affects the output voltage quality of the medium frequency power supply system. In a power supply system with single power source and multiple loads, as different lines between loads and power source are different in length, series dynamic voltage restorers (DVR) are set at the loads side to keep loads voltage constant in this paper. By means of analyzing impedance of transmission line and the voltage drop on it, a capacity calculation model of dynamic voltage restorer under normal working conditions is found. The series dynamic voltage restorer based on proportional-resonant (PR) control is used to guarantee a satisfactory output quality of the system. Simulation and experiment results verify that the series dynamic voltage restorer based on PR control effectively solves the problems of source voltage perturbation and line voltage drop in the medium frequency power supply system.

articleTitle: A new-type robust model-based fault diagnosis method with H2 filtering
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: A robust model-based fault diagnosis method with H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> filtering is proposed for motor system. It draws on the model-based fault diagnosis method architecture and unites with robust control theory, and structurally consists of residual generator and decision-making. Its basic principle is to introduce mutual residual as the residual generator for fault detection, and apply H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-norm for fault isolation and location. It is employed in a four-phase PM fault-tolerant motor for open- and short-circuit fault diagnosis. The computation and simulation data, of the open- and short-circuit fault for a real four-phase PM fault-tolerant motor, has verified the validity and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A review of aero-engine blade fouling mechanism
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: As the heart of aircraft, aero-engine's performance is one of the influence factors of flight safety and fuel efficiency. The purpose of this paper is to study turbofan engine blade fouling's formation mechanism and development progress. Blade is one of the key parts of the whole turbofan engine which includes fan blades and axial compressor rotor and stator blades. Blade fouling is the process that tiny particles adhere to the surface of blade with the increase of engine flight hours. This study analyzes the source of the fouling contaminants and particle kinematics, dynamics and fouling simulation process, which are based on the mechanism of blade fouling and particles deposition.

articleTitle: Experimental study of load ports independent control on pneumatic servo system with gravitational load
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Traditional pneumatic servo systems usually use load ports linkage control, but it doesn't always work well. When the gravitational load in the systems is large, conventional pneumatic servo systems can not meet the needs of high positioning accuracy. This study takes the method of independent load ports control technology. The method presented in this paper has one modification. It controls two chambers of the cylinder with different strategies, respectively. Displacement and pressure closed loop and BP neural network PID algorithm are used in the new system, which can set the PID parameters in real time, reduce the positioning error, improve the control precision effectively. At the same time, the pressure at two chambers of the cylinder at a low level, which can save more energy.

articleTitle: Static characteristics of four-way jet-pipe valve
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: Mechanism of four-way jet-pipe valve is analyzed in detail by dividing the entire process into two stage, including stream jetting and stream receiving processes. Mathematical model of the whole working process of four-way jet-pipe valve is obtained based on the Bernoulli's equation. Receiving area of symmetric receivers varying along the jet nozzle deflection is deduced according to geometry. By theoretical analysis and mathematical calculation, pressure recovery increases with the increase of receiving area. On the basis of a fixed distance of 0.4 mm between the nozzle and receivers, 1) in the condition of radius of the jet nozzle is equal to that of receivers, pressure recovery at null position is 64.5% of the supply pressure; 2) in the condition of radius of jet nozzle is smaller than that of receivers, pressure recovery at null position is lower than 64.5% of the supply pressure; 3) in the condition of radius of jet nozzle is lager than that of receivers, pressure recovery at null position is higher than 64.5% of the supply pressure, and it moves high along with the radius gap. Even if the jet nozzle moves to the max deflection position, pressure recovery at receivers is higher than back pressure of return oil. The highest pressure gain of loading pressure can be obtained at the situation of radius of the jet nozzle is equal to that of receivers. The theoretical results' tendency is basically in agreement with the experimental results.

articleTitle: The application of medium frequency AC and DC electrical energy conversion sharing the same main circuit in dual output aviation power supply
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: As aviation power supply is developing to be increasingly integrated, by sharing the same main circuit, AC and DC dual output can be achieved through the same power supply to greatly improve power integration and power density. However, transformation ratio and transformer leakage in AC conversion can cause voltage drop in DC output and thus fail to meet the rated voltage of aviation DC power. To solve this problem, this paper describes the working principles of AC and DC transformation sharing the same main circuit and its control strategies, elaborates the relationship between transformation ratio and Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) of AC output voltage through comprehensive analysis, and confirms the effects of switching frequency and leakage inductance of transformer on DC output through experiments before arriving at the conclusion that reducing the leakage inductance of transformer can balance both THD of AC output voltage and DC output voltage and thus achieve dual output in the same power supply.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of reservoir in the liquid cooling system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Aircraft Utility Systems (AUS)
abstract: In this paper the dynamic simulation of the Reservoir in the liquid cooling system is studied using the simulink software. The expansion function of the liquid cooling system is realized by expansion tank usually. For a certain type aircraft, the expansion function of the liquid cooling system is realized by pressurized expansion tank and Reservoir together. Dynamic Simulation of Reservoir is very important to know which factor affect the Reservoir design. According the simulation, the liquid level of the reserior is affect by back-pressure only, different diameter of the pipe affect the time to steady-state.
